verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Haa-meem
Tanzeelun minar-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Kitaabun fussilat aayaatuhu qur'aanan arabiyyan liqawmin ya'lamoon
Basheeran wa nadheeran fa-a'rada aktharuhum fahum laa yasma'oon
Wa qaaloo quloobunaa fee akinnatin mimmaa tad'oonaa ilayhi wa fee aadhaaninaa waqrun wa min bayninaa wa baynika hijaabun fa'mal innanaa aamiloon
Qul innamaa anaa basharun mithlukum yoohaa ilayya annamaa ilaahukum ilaahun waahidun fastaqeemoo ilayhi wastaghfiroohu wa waylun lilmushrikeen
Al-ladheena laa yu'toonaz-zakaata wa hum bil-aakhirati hum kaafiroon
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoon
Qul a'innakum latakfuroona billadhee khalaqal-arda fee yawmayni wa taj'aloona lahu andaadan dhaalika rabbul-aalameen
Wa ja'ala feehaa rawaasiya min fawqihaa wa baaraka feehaa wa qaddara feehaa aqwaatahaa fee arba'ati ayyaamin sawaa'an lis-saa'ileen
Thumma istawaa ilas-samaa'i wa hiya dukhaanun faqaala lahaa wa lil-ardi ii'tiyaa taw'an aw karhan qaalataa ataynaa taa'i'een
Faqadaahunna sab'a samaawaatin fee yawmayni wa awhaa fee kulli samaa'in amrahaa wa zayyannas-samaa'ad-dunyaa bimasaabeeha wa hifzan dhaalika taqdeerul-azeezil-aleem
Fa-in a'radoo faqul andhartukum saa'iqatan mithla saa'iqati aadin wa thamood
Idh jaa'athumur-rusulu min bayni aydeehim wa min khalfihim allaa ta'budoo illaa Allaaha qaaloo law shaa'a rabbunaa la-anzala malaa'ikatan fa-innaa bimaa ursiltum bihi kaafiroon
Fa-ammaa aadun fastakbaroo fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi wa qaaloo man ashaddu minnaa quwwatan awalam yaraw annallaahal-ladhee khalaqahum huwa ashaddu minhum quwwatan wa kaanoo bi-aayaatinaa yajhadoon
Fa-arsalnaa alayhim reehan sarsaran fee ayyaamin nahisaatin linudheeqahum adhaabal-khizyi fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wa la-adhaabul-aakhirati akhzaa wa hum laa yunsaroon
Wa ammaa thamoodu fahadaynaahum fastahabbul-amaa alal-hudaa fa-akhadhathum saa'iqatul-adhaabil-hooni bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
Wa najjaynal-ladheena aamanoo wa kaanoo yattaqoon
Wa yawma yuhsharu a'daa'u Allaahi ilan-naari fahum yooza'oon
Hattaa idhaa maa jaa'oohaa shahida alayhim sam'uhum wa absaaruhum wa julooduhum bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
Wa qaaloo lijuloodihim lima shahidtum alaynaa qaaloo antaqanaa Allaahul-ladhee antaqa kulla shay'in wa huwa khalaqakum awwala marratin wa ilayhi turja'oon
Wa maa kuntum tastatiroona an yashhada alaykum sam'ukum wa laa absaarukum wa laa juloodukum wa laakin zanantum annallaaha laa ya'lamu katheeran mimmaa ta'maloon
Wa dhaalikum zannukumul-ladhee zanantum birabbikum ardaakum fa-asbahtum minal-khaasireen
Fa-in yasbiroo fan-naaru mathwan lahum wa in yasta'tiboo famaa hum minal-mu'tabeen
Wa qayyadnaa lahum quranaa'a fazayyanoo lahum maa bayna aydeehim wa maa khalfahum wa haqqa alayhimul-qawlu fee umamin qad khalat min qablihim minal-jinni wal-insi innahum kaanoo khaasireen
Wa qaalal-ladheena kafaroo laa tasma'oo lihadhal-qur'aani wal-ghaw feehi la-allakum taghliboon
Falanudheeqannal-ladheena kafaroo adhaaban shadeedan wa lanajziyannahum aswa'al-ladhee kaanoo ya'maloon
Dhaalika jazaa'u a'daa'i Allaahin-naaru lahum feehaa daarul-khuldi jazaa'an bimaa kaanoo bi-aayaatinaa yajhadoon
Wa qaalal-ladheena kafaroo rabbanaa arinal-ladhayni adallaanaa minal-jinni wal-insi naj'alhumaa tahta aqdaaminaa liyakoonaa minal-asfaleen
Innal-ladheena qaaloo rabbunaa Allaahu thumma istaqaamoo tatanazzalu alayhimul-malaa'ikatu allaa takhaafoo wa laa tahzanoo wa abshiroo bil-jannatil-latee kuntum too'adoon
Nahnu awliyaa'uukum fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wa fil-aakhirati wa lakum feehaa maa tashtahee anfusukum wa lakum feehaa maa tadda'oon
Nuzulan min ghafoorin Raheem
Wa man ahsanu qawlan mimman da'aa ilaa Allaahi wa amila saalihan wa qaala innanee minal-muslimeen
Wa laa tastawil-hasanatu wa las-sayyi'atu idfa billatee hiya ahsanu fa-idhal-ladhee baynaka wa baynahu adaawatun ka'annahu waliyyun hameem
Wa maa yulaqqaahaa illal-ladheena sabaroo wa maa yulaqqaahaa illaa dhoo hazzin azeem
Wa immaa yanzaghannaka minash-shaytaani nazghun fasta'idh Billaahi innahu huwas-samee'ul-aleem
Wa min aayaatihil-laylu wan-nahaaru wash-shamsu wal-qamaru laa tasjudoo lish-shamsi wa laa lilqamari wasjudoo Lillaahil-ladhee khalaqahunna in kuntum iyyaahu ta'budoon
Fa-ini istakbaroo fa-al-ladheena inda rabbika yusabbihoona lahu bil-layli wan-nahaari wa hum laa yas'amoon
Wa min aayaatihi annaka taral-arda khaashi'atan fa-idhaa anzalnaa alayhal-maa'a ihtazzat wa rabat innal-ladhee ahyaahaa lamuhyil-mawtaa innahu alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Innal-ladheena yulhidoona fee aayaatinaa laa yakhfawna alaynaa afaman yulqaa fin-naari khayrun am man ya'tee aaminan yawmal-qiyaamati i'maloo maa shi'tum innahu bimaa ta'maloona baseer
Innal-ladheena kafaroo bidh-dhikri lammaa jaa'ahum wa innahu lakitaabun azeez
Laa ya'teehil-baatilu min bayni yadayhi wa laa min khalfihi tanzeelun min hakeemin hameed
Maa yuqaalu laka illaa maa qad qeela lir-rusuli min qablika inna rabbaka ladhoo maghfiratin wa dhoo iqaabin aleem

Wa law ja'alnaahu qur'aanan a'jamiyyan laqaaloo lawlaa fussilat aayaatuhu a'a'jamiyyun wa arabiyyun qul huwa lilladheena aamanoo hudan wa shifaa'un wal-ladheena laa yu'minoona fee aadhaanihim waqrun wa huwa alayhim aman ulaa'ika yunaadawna min makaanin ba'eed
Wa laqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba fakhtulifa feehi wa lawlaa kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laqudiya baynahum wa innahum lafee shakkin minhu mureeb
Man amila saalihan falinafsihi wa man asaa'a fa-alayhaa wa maa rabbuka bizallaamin lil-abeed

Ilayhi yuraddu ilmus-saa'ati wa maa takhruju min thamaraatin min akmaamihaa wa maa tahmilu min unthaa wa laa tada'u illaa bi-ilmihi wa yawma yunaadeehim ayna shurakaa'ee qaaloo aadhannaaka maa minnaa min shaheed
Wa dalla anhum maa kaanoo yad'oona min qablu wa zannoo maa lahum min mahees
Laa yas'amul-insaanu min du'aa'il-khayri wa in massahush-sharru faya'oosun qanoot

Wa la-in adhaqnaahu rahmatan minnaa min ba'di darraa'a massathu layaqoolanna haadhaa lee wa maa azunnus-saa'ata qaa'imatan wa la-in ruji'tu ilaa rabbee inna lee indahu lalhusnaa falanunabbi'annal-ladheena kafaroo bimaa amiloo wa lanudheeqannahum min adhaabin ghaleez
Wa idhaa an'amnaa alal-insaani a'rada wa na'aa bijaanibihi wa idhaa massahush-sharru fadhoo du'aa'in areed
Qul ara'aytum in kaana min indi Allaahi thumma kafartum bihi man adallu mimman huwa fee shiqaaqin ba'eed
Sanureehim aayaatinaa fil-aafaaqi wa fee anfusihim hattaa yatabayyana lahum annahul-haqqu awalam yakfi birabbika annahu alaa kulli shay'in shaheed
Alaa innahum fee miryatin min liqaa'i rabbihim alaa innahu bikulli shay'in muheet
